clauses.clause: Seven route regions connect in order: creek/corn → farmstead and broken farms → restricted military zone → safe research hangar → dispersal route/complex. Total target ≈15 min with no idle padding.
clauses.note: High native complete-input seed1 reaches cure release at 1349.35s (22m29.35s), 449.35s above 900s and 149.35s above the evaluator 1200s upper bound; low reaches release at 1194.37s (19m54.37s). High has four deaths and checkpoint retries, low three; these times include retry travel and do not establish an independently skilled or death-free duration. Native objective ledger visits crash, farmstead, restricted zone, research hangar and delivery/dispersal in that order; full visual region connectivity and idle-padding attribution remain unmeasured. Repro: L10_PACING_SEED=1 L10_PACING_TIERS=high,low L10_PACING_MAX_SECONDS=1800 npx tsx tools/qa/l10-pacing.ts --out <file>.

evidence.what: Native high/low complete-input timing, objective and death ledger.
Acceptance evaluator applies 600–1200 s as the numerical band for approximately 15 minutes.

notes: High-tier native route duration counterexample against the evaluator’s 10–20 minute band; physical route remains incomplete and seven-region visual review is open.
